failure.message: You can only execute one statement at a time.
failure.trigger: The extracted model output contained two semicolon-separated SELECT statements.
failure.gate_behavior: The runner stopped before writing a final-score row for the failing call.

root_cause.detail: Under Python 3.10.11, sqlite3.Warning is not a subclass of sqlite3.Error. The frozen safe_execute function catches sqlite3.Error only, so a multi-statement prediction escapes the intended classification path and terminates the run.
root_cause.required_protocol_correction: A new frozen revision must deterministically classify multi-statement predictions as PARSE_ERROR or catch sqlite3.Warning, with regression tests, before another full run.
